acceptance.trial_handoff: Copyable assessment and decision sheets specify actual activity, authority, people, rights, costs, stop conditions and post-trial outcome. No prefilled approval.
acceptance.boundaries: Field-research estimate is not trial pricing; private evidence needs an agreed restricted home; booking, fieldwork and publication remain separate. WORK172 retains dependencies.

scenario_review.result: Unknown, not gap evidenced or declined; continue desk work or defer; no trial-ready inference.

scenario_review.result: Exclude recording only if the activity stands alone; still establish all visit, access and cost conditions. No publication right implied.

scenario_review.result: Record scoped gap, discuss fit privately and revise/defer; do not label the whole venue universally inaccessible.

scenario_review.result: Conflicting or stale; preserve both and resolve the applicable quote before relying on it.

scenario_review.result: No average or score overrides the missing permission; proposal not ready.
